query:
SELECT EXISTS(
               SELECT 1
               FROM user_group_members ugm
               JOIN user_groups ug ON ug.id = ugm.group_id AND ug.is_active = TRUE
               JOIN user_group_permissions ugp ON ugp.group_id = ug.id
               WHERE ugm.user_id = $1
                 AND ugp.permission = ANY($2::varchar(80)[])
           ) AS "exists!"
